ValidationRule.description: Prevents anyone from making an edit on a closed case (For Issues, task, cac, ncsp, and retention cases only)
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(OR(ispickval(Status, "Closed"),ispickval(Status, "Complete"),ispickval(Status, "Cancelled"),ispickval(Status, "Duplicate"), ispickval(Status, "Inactive")), NOT(ISCHANGED(Status)), NOT(ISCHANGED(Open_Tasks__c)), NOT(ISCHANGED(Follow_Up_Required__c)),NOT(ISCHANGED(Survey__c)), OR($RecordType.Name = "CLAS – Data Management", RecordType.DeveloperName = "Retention_RM", RecordType.DeveloperName = "Retention_SH", $RecordType.Name = "NCSP: DMS", $RecordType.Name = "NCSP: DP New Customer Setup", $RecordType.Name = "NCSP: SKP Department Add Only", $RecordType.Name == "NCSP: Tech Services New Customer Setup", $RecordType.Name == "NCSP: Upsell", $RecordType.Name =="NCSP: New Customer Setup", $RecordType.Name == 'NCSP: SKP New Customer Setup',$RecordType.Name = "Ad Hoc Report and Dashboard Request Cases" ), $Profile.Name <> "Contract Admin NA",$Profile.Name <> "NAS Support Manager",$Profile.Name <> "NAS Support Manager TCOP", $Profile.Name <> "NAS Support Agent",$Profile.Name <> "IM_Custom Sys Admin",$Profile.Name <> "IM_Sales Ops Super User", $Profile.Name <> "IME_Custom Sys Admin",$Profile.Name <> "IME_Super_User" )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: No edits can be made on a closed, complete, cancelled, inactive, or duplicate case. If you wish to make an edit please reopen the case by changing the status. Note: Only managers, coordinators, and administrators can reopen a case.
